# Josephine Barry

[Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood)

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Aunt Josephine  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042)</sub>
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is an elderly woman with a wrinkled cheek and sharp, snapping black eyes that show no signs of dimming. She wears gold-rimmed glasses and maintains a thin, prim, and rigid appearance, often seen knitting fiercely by the fire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## Personality

Josephine Barry is a prim and proper lady who is known to be hospitable to her guests. Though she maintains high standards and can be quick to scold, she is also described as a rather selfish person who has rarely cared for anyone besides herself.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## History

Josephine Barry, an elderly aunt to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), was initially furious when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally jumped on her in a spare-room bed during an overnight visit. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) went to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly, Miss Barry was won over by her dramatic honesty and charm, deciding to extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue paying for Diana's music lessons. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her home in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), realizing how much she enjoyed Anne's lively company. During Anne's studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), Miss Barry welcomed her for visits at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and was present at Commencement to share in the pride when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery scholarship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P2](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P3](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P4](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), +181 more_

## Quotes

> "and I can’t prevent her, for her father aids and abets her. She’s always poring over a book. I’m glad she has the prospect of a playmate—perhaps it will take her more out-of-doors."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry first encountered [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) under chaotic circumstances when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally jumped on her in a spare-room bed. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited her directly to offer a dramatic and honest apology, Miss Barry was completely won over by her charm. She subsequently developed a deep fondness for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), coming to admire and feel proud of her young friend.

- Friend of — admires and is proud of her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry is the grand-aunt of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Aunt Josephine pays for Diana's music lessons. Although an unexpected mishap in the spare-room bed initially caused an uproar between them, Miss Barry ultimately decided to remain in town and continue supporting her niece's education.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011)</sub>
